# pegas

> Agent-native zero-config Caddy reverse proxy for Docker multi-app VPS setups.

## Core Concepts
- Manages single reverse proxy (Caddy 2) listening on :80 and :443.
- All Docker projects attach to a shared Docker bridge network named `pegas-network`.
- Never expose 80:80 or 443:443 in application compose files.
- Each project gets an isolated declarative drop-in configuration in `conf.d/<projectName>.caddy`.
- Hot-reloads Caddy via API with zero downtime and automatic validation rollback.
- Auto-provisions Let's Encrypt SSL on first request.
- Local dev: trusted HTTPS via `pegas ca install` (one-time), clean URLs on port 443 (`[service].[project].localhost`).

## CLI Usage for Agents
- `npx @netrunner714/pegas init [options]` (--force, --dry-run, --cwd) — Init Pegas in current project.
- `npx @netrunner714/pegas update [options]` (--latest, --cwd) — Update @netrunner714/pegas to latest version.
- `npx pegas dev -- <command>` (--cwd) — Start local HTTPS proxy and development environment.
- `npx pegas dev` (--cwd) — Start local HTTPS proxy and development environment.
- `npx pegas deploy <env> [options]` (-e, --cwd) — Deploy project containers and configure Caddy routes.
- `npx pegas down [options]` (--cwd) — Tear down project containers and remove Caddy routes.
- `npx pegas ca install` (--dry-run) — Manage local Root CA for trusted dev HTTPS (install/remove).
- `npx pegas ca remove` (--dry-run) — Manage local Root CA for trusted dev HTTPS (install/remove).
- `npx pegas status [options]` — Check gateway health and active project routes.
- `npx pegas llms [options]` — Print machine-readable LLM context.

## Global Options
- `--gateway-dir` <path> — Override path to gateway directory.
- `--json` — Output machine-readable JSON (ideal for AI agents and scripts).
- `-h, --help` — Show this help message.
- `-v, --version` — Show version.

## Example Docker Compose Patch for Any App
```yaml
services:
  app:
    expose:
      - "3000"
    networks:
      pegas-network:
        aliases:
          - <projectName>-app

networks:
  pegas-network:
    external: true
```
